content:
Well, my dear one, I may have been gone a while, but I can still see the twinkle in your eyes as you listen to my tales. I may not exactly understand these new age video game things you're into, but let your old great-grandma try. 

There's a place, they call it Tarkov, hidden behind the swirl of darkness. Reminds me of the tales of knights and kings, like the warriors of old, they too seek their glory. Now, there are keys in this strange land. These keys unlock doors, yes, treasures hidden in the dark.

The first one, it's an Edge of Darkness key. Deep within the bowels of this land, it is said to open a door which leads you into the underworld. They say it hides a wealth of riches or untold horrors, depends on how lucky you are, I suppose.

Then, there are other keys, spread throughout the land. It seems you might need to fight or negotiate your way to get them. Each one - a mystery waiting to unfold. Each one - a chapter in this grand story, penned by unseen forces.

Now, my dear, as unusual as these stories are, I hope they still give you the same peace, the same sense of adventure that the elder tales did. But remember, as much as these keys and this land of Tarkov might be filled with excitement, the greatest treasures are still found in the heart, my dear. Good night.
